My family and I moved to the Netherlands earlier this summer, so that I could study for a PhD. We plan to be here for the next 5 years. We received a residence permit for this period as well. Since moving here we have run into some problems obtaining health insurance. Since I do not have a job here and am a self-funded doctoral student, none of the health insurance companies will give us a plan. We have seen student health insurance plans, but they are not great options for families. AON, for instance, does not cover maternity costs for partners. We would like a plan that is comprehensive, covering routine preventative care as well as emergencies. 

Has anyone else faced this situation? If so, what healthcare company or plan would you recommend?
